issues.explanation: Chapter 46 says Zhou Yu intends to kill Cai Zhong and Cai He as sacrificial victims when deploying, but Chapter 47 has them still active and being tested without explaining that plan was abandoned or postponed.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a brief transition stating that Zhou Yu changed plans and kept Cai Zhong and Cai He under surveillance so Kan Ze and Gan Ning could expose them.
